%@ index T ordered=0 cyclic=0 :: Time periods.
%@ index S ordered=0 cyclic=0 :: Stations.
%@ index L ordered=0 cyclic=0 :: Train lines.

%@ param d shape=D kind=scalar domain=time_duration :: Duration of each disruption.
%@ param c shape=T,L kind=matrix domain=non_negative :: Original timetable (number of trains at each time period and train line).
%@ param p shape=S,L kind=matrix domain=non_negative :: Platform capacity at each station and train line.
%@ param r shape=S,L kind=matrix domain=non_negative :: Rolling stock circulation at each station and train line.
%@ var x shape=T,L domain=integer role=primary drole=rescheduling lo=0 hi=- :: Number of trains at each time period and train line after rescheduling.
%@ var y shape=T,L domain=binary role=primary drole=cancellation lo=- hi=- :: Cancellation of trains at each time period and train line.
%@ var z shape=T,L domain=integer role=primary drole=retiming lo=- hi=- :: Retiming of trains at each time period and train line.
%@ var w shape=S,L domain=integer role=primary drole=platform_usage lo=0 hi=- :: Platform usage at each station and train line.
%@ obj sense=min name=rescheduling_cost combination=sum :: Minimize the total cost of rescheduling (cancellations, delays, and platform usage).
%@ con rescheduling kind=inequality domain=non_negative indicator=- :: Rescheduling constraint (number of trains after rescheduling).
%@ con cancellation kind=inequality domain=binary indicator=- :: Cancellation constraint (cancellation of trains).
%@ con retiming kind=inequality domain=integer indicator=- :: Retiming constraint (retiming of trains).
%@ con platform kind=inequality domain=non_negative indicator=- :: Platform capacity constraint (platform usage).
%@ con rolling_stock kind=inequality domain=non_negative indicator=- :: Rolling stock circulation constraint (rolling stock usage).
\begin{align}
  \min\quad & \sum_{t \in \mathcal{T}, l \in \mathcal{L}} y_{t,l} + \sum_{t \in \mathcal{T}, l \in \mathcal{L}} z_{t,l} + \sum_{s \in \mathcal{S}, l \in \mathcal{L}} w_{s,l} \tag{rescheduling\_cost} \\
  & x_{t,l} \le c_{t,l} + z_{t,l} \qquad \forall t \in \mathcal{T},\; \forall l \in \mathcal{L} \tag{rescheduling} \\
  & y_{t,l} \ge x_{t,l} - c_{t,l} \qquad \forall t \in \mathcal{T},\; \forall l \in \mathcal{L} \tag{cancellation} \\
  & z_{t,l} \ge x_{t,l} - c_{t,l} \qquad \forall t \in \mathcal{T},\; \forall l \in \mathcal{L} \tag{retiming} \\
  & w_{s,l} \le p_{s,l} \qquad \forall s \in \mathcal{S},\; \forall l \in \mathcal{L} \tag{platform} \\
  & \sum_{t \in \mathcal{T}} x_{t,l} \le r_{s,l} \qquad \forall s \in \mathcal{S},\; \forall l \in \mathcal{L} \tag{rolling\_stock} \\
\end{align}
